verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing promises "customized summaries" after every meeting, a glancing first-party claim that notes can be shaped. Nothing in the pack documents custom templates, saved prompts, or different formats per meeting type. AskFred's ad-hoc Q&A is a different feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented custom note templates, saved or reusable prompts, per-meeting-type assignment (discovery call, 1:1, standup), configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format

citations.quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
